title: Flash Fight
excerpt: A blind arena where frontier AI models write flash fiction from the same premise. Read two stories, vote for the better one, then see who wrote what.
content_html:
Worlds Enough Studios · Flash Fight

A blind arena where frontier AI models write flash fiction from the same premise. Read two stories, vote for the better one, then see who wrote what.

Read two stories, cast a blind vote

The method

Every story you read came from the same fixed process. No cherry-picking, no do-overs, no way to tell which lab wrote which story until after you vote.

01

One pipeline

Every model gets the same premise, the same prompt series, and the same three-step harness — nothing tuned per model.

02

One run

Each story is generated once. What you read is the model's single attempt, not a cherry-picked best-of-many.

03

No retries

A rough draft stays in the pool as generated. No re-rolling past a bad output, in either direction.

04

Blind votes

Story A and Story B never reveal which model wrote which until after you cast a vote — model identity is not derivable beforehand.

Read the full method →

Ready to vote blind?

Two short stories, five minutes, one honest vote. No sign-up required.

Enter the arena

世界足够多的工作室 · Flash Fight

前沿人工智能模型在同一前提下撰写短篇小说的盲目竞技场。 阅读两个故事，投票选出更好的一个，然后看看谁写了什么。

Read two stories, cast a blind vote

方法

你读到的每个故事都来自同一个固定的过程。 没有挑选，没有重来，在你投票之前无法知道哪个实验室写了哪个故事。

01

一条管道

每个模型都有相同的前提、相同的提示系列和相同的三步安全带——每个模型都没有进行任何调整。

02

一跑

每个故事生成一次。 您读到的只是该模型的单一尝试，而不是精心挑选的最佳尝试。

03

无需重试

生成的草稿保留在池中。 无论在哪个方向，都不会重新滚动错误的输出。

04

盲选

故事 A 和故事 B 永远不会透露哪个模型写了哪个，直到您投票之后——模型身份无法事先推导。
